page.content:
Campaign 3 party of Imogen, Laudna, Orym, Fearne, and the Jrusar crew.

How Bells Hells connects

  • Work: Campaign 3 — Bells Hells are the player party of Campaign 3.
  • Character: Imogen Temult — Imogen Temult is the psionic sorcerer of Bells Hells.
  • Character: Laudna — Laudna is the hollow-one warlock of Bells Hells.

What is Bells Hells?

Bells Hells are the Campaign 3 party gathered in Jrusar — Imogen Temult, Laudna, Orym, Fearne, Ashton, Fresh Cut Grass, and later Chetney — who walk into the Ruidus crisis.

Key threads lead to Campaign 3, Imogen Temult and Laudna.
